gloss: academic society, learned society, academic conference

definitions.explanation: An organization of scholars or professionals in a particular field of study.
A meeting or conference held by an academic society.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}{言語|げんご}{学会|がっかい}に{入会|にゅうかい}した。
examples.english: I joined the Linguistic Society of Japan.

examples.japanese: {来月|らいげつ}の{学会|がっかい}で{発表|はっぴょう}する。
examples.english: I will present at the conference next month.

examples.japanese: {学会|がっかい}で{論文|ろんぶん}を{発表|はっぴょう}した。
examples.english: I presented a paper at the academic conference.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{学会|がっかい}{発表|はっぴょう} (conference presentation)
・{学会|がっかい}に{参加|さんか}する (to participate in a conference)
・{学会|がっかい}{員|いん} (member of an academic society)

EXAMPLES OF SOCIETIES:
・{日本|にほん}{物理|ぶつり}{学会|がっかい} (Physical Society of Japan)
・{日本|にほん}{医学|いがく}{学会|がっかい} (Japan Medical Association)
